description: Check the status using the quote_status_key you received. Before confirmation it can report Avventer bekreftelse; after confirmation it requires the customer to have allowed status sharing. Read-only. status is one of: Avventer bekreftelse (customer has not confirmed yet), Mottatt (request received: a request for an offer, NOT an order), Under behandling, Avventer pris (Formheim is working on it), Klar til godkjenning (offer sent, waiting for the customer's approval), Estimat godkjent, Til vurdering (customer must review models and final price), Korrigering ønsket, Ny versjon på vei, Godkjent (approved, order not created yet), Avslått (declined), Bestilt (the only status where an order exists; comes with order_number). meaning and next_step explain the status in Norwegian: relay them to the customer in your own words and do not claim more than they say. Call it an order only when order_placed is true; payment, production and delivery are never shown here. On ACCESS_DENIED, stop polling and ask the customer to use the Formheim page or contact Formheim; do not call submit_to_offer to recover status access.
